about: Each example is one prism/prompt/1 prompt for an app in the spirit of a real Prism project. The builder writes the whole app from it, and the pages workflow verifies every one in the pinned SDK before the site is published.

examples.summary: LexLean and Lean 4 formalization of Wolfram's Rule 30 with verified artifacts.
A tactical wargame whose Nemesis Core engine is modeled and verified with LexLean and PrismPM.
The CIRIS ethical reasoning engine and its wisdom-based deferral, on PrismPM and LexLean.
A local legal matter workspace authored in LexLean and compiled by PrismPM.
Bitcoin proof of work as a UOR-ADDR realization.
A first-person garden of acoustic biomes and plants that answer the player.
Any Cargo workspace to a complete Prism model, every facet.
This site: a Prism model of developer relations, applied to itself.
Prism AI Foundry: describe an app, and it is built, proved and published.
UORC, lossless compression whose compressed object is an executable Universal Object Reference.
Find, verify and open Prism apps by their address.
BFT consensus that references transactions instead of re-sending them.
A register of results keyed by the kappa of their question.
Typed content addressing: one label for one meaning.
